hindi: दूष्यों से और शत्रुओं से शुद्ध दो प्रकार की होती है।
english: From the treasonable and from enemies, the pure [one] is twofold.
notes: The feminine noun that śuddhā agrees with is not stated in this line (presumably the group or state under discussion); the translation does not supply it. Glossary: dūṣya = the treasonable.

hindi: दूष्यों से शुद्ध होने पर नगरवासियों अथवा जनपदवासियों के प्रति दण्ड को छोड़कर अन्य उपायों का प्रयोग करे।
english: When [it] is pure of the treasonable, [he] should apply the means that exclude force toward the townsmen or the country people.
notes: dūṣya-śuddhāyām is feminine, agreeing with an unstated feminine noun (as in unit 1). Subject [he] is implied. daṇḍa here is the upāya 'force' (glossary).

hindi: क्योंकि दण्ड बड़े जनसमूह पर डालना असम्भव है।
english: For force is impossible to cast upon a great multitude.
notes: kṣeptum is rendered literally (to cast, to throw); a looser rendering is 'to inflict' or 'to apply'. mahā-jana = great multitude, the common people.

hindi: अथवा डाला जाने पर उस प्रयोजन को पूरा नहीं करेगा और दूसरा अनर्थ उत्पन्न करेगा।
english: Or, when cast, [it] would not accomplish that purpose and would produce another harm.
notes: Subject (force, daṇḍa) is carried from unit 3. anartha is rendered 'harm' (literally the opposite of artha, 'purpose/profit'); alternative 'mischief' or 'an undesirable result'. 'ca-arthaṃ' and 'ca-anartham' are unsandhied joins in the e-text.

hindi: किन्तु इनके मुख्य लोगों के प्रति दाण्डकर्मिक के समान आचरण करे।
english: But toward the chiefs of these, [he] should act like the dāṇḍa-karmika.
notes: dāṇḍa-karmika is kept untranslated: it may name a topic or section (punitive procedure) or a kind of officer; the line does not decide. Subject [he] is implied.

hindi: शत्रु से शुद्ध होने पर जहाँ से शत्रु प्रधान हो या बनाया जाना हो, वहाँ से साम आदि उपायों द्वारा सिद्धि पाने का यत्न करे।
english: When [it] is pure of enemies, from where the enemy is principal or is to be made [so], from there [he] should seek to obtain success by conciliation and the rest.
notes: kāryaḥ 'to be made' is read with pradhānaḥ ('is to be made principal'); an alternative is 'is to be dealt with'. yataḥ/tataḥ are taken as 'from where / from there'; the noun (quarter, side) is not stated. sāma-ādi = conciliation and the rest.

words.gloss: success of the principal and the dependent

hindi: प्रधान की सिद्धि स्वामी पर निर्भर है, आयत्त की सिद्धि मन्त्रियों पर निर्भर है, और प्रधान तथा आयत्त की सिद्धि दोनों पर निर्भर है।
english: Success of the principal depends on the king; success of the dependent depends on the counsellors; success of the principal and the dependent depends on both.
notes: The token 'āyattā-āyatta.siddhiḥ' is read as predicate āyattā + subject āyatta-siddhiḥ (parallel to the first and third clauses). The sense of āyatta as a noun ('the dependent') is uncertain; the three kinds are left as the text names them. mantrin rendered 'counsellor' to keep it apart from amātya = minister.

words.gloss: of the treasonable and the non-treasonable
from the state of being mixed

hindi: दूष्यों और अदूष्यों के मिले हुए होने के कारण आमिश्रा है।
english: Because of the mixing of the treasonable and the non-treasonable, [it is] āmiśrā (the 'mixed' one).
notes: āmiśrā is a technical name of the second kind of group; kept as a term with its literal sense 'mixed'. The copula is supplied.

hindi: आमिश्रा में अदूष्य से सिद्धि है।
english: In the āmiśrā, success [comes] from the non-treasonable.
notes: Predicate supplied as a bare copula/'comes' in the English bracket.

hindi: क्योंकि आलम्बन के अभाव में आलम्बित नहीं रहते।
english: For in the absence of support, the supported do not exist.
notes: ālambitāḥ (from ā-√lamb, 'to hang on, rely on') is rendered 'the supported'; the alternative is 'those who rely on (it)'. The line is brief and the referents are not stated.

hindi: मित्रों और अमित्रों के एक हो जाने के कारण परमिश्रा है।
english: Because allies and enemies become one, [it is] para-miśrā (mixed with the other).
notes: para-miśrā is a technical name of the third kind of group; para is rendered 'the other'; it may mean 'the enemy'. Copula supplied.

hindi: परमिश्रा में मित्र से सिद्धि है।
english: In the para-miśrā, success [comes] from the ally.
notes: Predicate supplied as a bare copula.

hindi: क्योंकि मित्र के साथ सन्धि सरल है, अमित्र के साथ नहीं।
english: For a treaty with an ally is easy, not with an enemy.
notes: The closing iti is not rendered. The last token 'na-amitreṇa-iti' is an unsandhied join.

hindi: यदि मित्र सन्धि न चाहे तो बार-बार उपजाप करे।
english: If the ally does not wish for a treaty, [he] should repeatedly [practise] secret instigation.
notes: mitram is taken as neuter nominative (the ally); the object of upajapet is not stated. upa-√jap = secret instigation (glossary upajāpa).

hindi: तब गुप्तचरों द्वारा अमित्र से भेद कराकर मित्र को प्राप्त करे।
english: Then, having caused a split from the enemy through secret agents, [he] should win the ally.
notes: The one split off is not stated (presumably the ally); not supplied.

hindi: अथवा मित्रों के संघ में जो अन्त में स्थित है, उसे प्राप्त करे।
english: Or, of the saṅgha of allies, the one who stands at the end, him [he] should win.
notes: saṅgha kept as saṅgha (glossary 11.1). anta-sthāyin is literally 'end-standing' (at the edge or end); the exact position is not defined here.

hindi: अन्त में स्थित के प्राप्त हो जाने पर मध्य में स्थित भिन्न हो जाते हैं।
english: When the end-stander is won, the middle-standers are split.

hindi: अथवा मध्य में स्थित को प्राप्त करे।
english: Or [he] should win the middle-stander.

hindi: मध्य में स्थित के प्राप्त हो जाने पर अन्त में स्थित संगठित नहीं होते।
english: When the middle-stander is won, the end-standers are not united.
notes: saṃhanyante (sam-√han passive) is rendered 'are united' (literally 'are knit together'); the alternative is 'are struck together'. The last token is 'na-anta.sthāyinaḥ' (na + anta-sthāyinaḥ).

hindi: और जिस प्रकार इनके आश्रय का भेद हो, उन उपायों का प्रयोग करे।
english: And in the way that there is a splitting of the refuge of these, [he] should apply those means.
notes: āśraya is rendered 'refuge' (alternatively 'support' or 'dependence'). Subject [he] is implied.

words.gloss: by praise of birth, family, learning and conduct
the benefits of the three times

hindi: धार्मिक को जाति, कुल, श्रुत और वृत्त की प्रशंसा से, सम्बन्ध से, पूर्व लोगों के तीनों कालों के उपकारों से अथवा दो अपकारों से सान्त्वना दे।
english: [He] should conciliate the righteous [one] by praise of birth, family, learning and conduct, by connection, by the benefits of the earlier ones through the three times, or by two injuries.
notes: upakārān is accusative while the other means are instrumental: the grammar may need a supplied verb ('recalling the benefits'), or the reading may be a slip for the instrumental; left as printed, not flagged as an error. apakārābhyām is dual (literally 'by two injuries'); which two is not stated. pūrveṣām 'of the earlier ones' (ancestors or predecessors) is left open.

words.gram: m. acc. sg. pres. part. desid. √labh
m. acc. sg. pres. part. ātm. √śaṅk

hindi: जिसका उत्साह निवृत्त हो गया है, जो युद्ध से थका हुआ है, जिसके उपाय विफल हो गए हैं, जो क्षय और व्यय से तथा प्रवास से पीड़ित है, जो शौच से अन्य को पाना चाहता है या अन्य से आशंका करता है, अथवा जिसमें मैत्री प्रधान है, अथवा जो कल्याणबुद्धि वाला है, उसे साम से साधे।
english: [He] should win over by conciliation [one] whose energy has ceased, [one] weary from war, [one] whose means are thwarted, [one] afflicted by loss and expenditure and by absence from home, [one] desiring another through purity or fearing from another, or [one] with friendship foremost, or [one] of benevolent mind.
notes: 'śaucena anyaṃ lipsamānam' is obscure: śauca is rendered literally 'purity' (alternatively 'honesty, integrity'), and what 'another' (anyam) is wanted is not stated; do not build on it. pravāsa literally 'living away from home'. sādhayet: 'win over' for caus. √sādh with a person as object (alternative 'bring to success'). Subject [he] and the correlative 'him' are implied.

words.gloss: preceded by the stationing of chief ascetics

hindi: लोभी अथवा क्षीण को प्रमुख तपस्वियों की स्थापना पहले करके दान से साधे।
english: [He] should win over the greedy or the depleted by a gift, preceded by the stationing of chief ascetics.
notes: avasthāpanā is rendered literally 'stationing, placing'; the role of the ascetics (for example as intermediaries or guarantors) is not stated and is not supplied. kṣīṇa: 'depleted, diminished' (alternatively 'impoverished').

words.gloss: release of what is to be given
following of what has been taken
giving back of what was taken

hindi: वह पाँच प्रकार का है — देने योग्य का त्याग, ग्रहण किए हुए का अनुवर्तन, लिए हुए का प्रतिदान, अपने द्रव्य का नया दान, और दूसरों के धन में स्वयं ग्रहण करने का दान।
english: That is fivefold: release of what is to be given, following of what has been taken, giving back of what was taken, giving of one's own wealth, new, and giving by one's own seizing in the property of others.
notes: The text says fivefold. The five are taken as: deya-visarga; gṛhīta-anuvartana; ātta-pratidāna; sva-dravya-dāna with apūrvam ('new') qualifying it; para-svayaṃgrāha-dāna ('para-sveṣu svayaṃ-grāha-dāna'). apūrvam could instead stand as a separate item or qualify the last, so the division is uncertain. gṛhīta-anuvartana is obscure: 'following of what has been taken' could also be 'compliance with the one who has taken'. The last clause is hard; render literally.

hindi: दान-कर्म।
english: Action of giving.
notes: A closing formula that ends the section on gifts (dāna); iti is not rendered as 'thus'. Glossary: karma = action.

words.gloss: suspicious of mutual hatred, enmity and seizure of land

hindi: परस्पर द्वेष, वैर और भूमि के हरण की शंका करने वाले को इनमें से किसी एक के द्वारा भेद कराए।
english: [One who is] suspicious of mutual hatred, enmity and seizure of land, [he] should split by any one of these.
notes: paraspara may qualify only dveṣa or the whole series; ataḥ anyatamena is read 'by any one of these' (the antecedent means are not stated); the alternative is 'therefore, by any one'. The person split is taken as the one suspicious.

hindi: अथवा डरपोक को प्रतिघात से — “सन्धि कर चुका यह तुम पर कर्म करेगा, इसका मित्र छोड़ दिया गया है, अथवा सन्धि में यह भीतर का नहीं है।”
english: Or the timid [he should split] by repulse: “This one, having made a treaty, will do action upon you; his ally has been released; or he is not within the treaty.”

text_flags.why: possible: the e-text marks karma and kariṣyati as compound members with '.', but kariṣyati is a finite future verb, so two separate words are expected

notes: The verb bhedayet is carried from unit 26. pratighāta is rendered 'repulse' (alternatives: counterstroke, obstruction). karma kariṣyati is literal ('will do action'); the intended action (for example against you) is not stated. nisṛṣṭam: 'released' (alternatively 'given up, handed over'). The closing iti only closes the quotation.

words.gloss: from the one to be marched against

hindi: जिसके माल अपने देश से या दूसरे देश से पण्य-भण्डार के रूप में आएँ, उसके उन मालों को “यातव्य से प्राप्त हुए” — ऐसा गुप्तचर फैलाएँ।
english: Whose wares might come, from his own region or from another region, as ware-stores: those [wares] of his the secret agents should circulate [as] “obtained from the one to be marched against.”
notes: The person meant by yasya/asya is not named. paṇya-agāra-tayā is rendered 'as ware-stores' (alternatively 'with the character of a warehouse'). cārayeyuḥ is rendered literally 'should circulate'; the verb has no stated object beyond tāni. The sentence structure is uncertain: tāni may be the object of cārayeyuḥ or of an implied 'report'.

words.gloss: by one given up to death

hindi: बहुत हो जाने पर मरने के लिए छोड़े हुए के द्वारा आदेश भेजे — “मेरे द्वारा तुम्हारे लिए यह माल अथवा पण्य-भण्डार भेजा गया है; सामवायिकों में पराक्रम करो, अथवा चले जाओ; तब पण का शेष पाओगे।”
english: When [it] has become plentiful, [he] should send an order by one given up to death: “This ware or ware-store has been sent to you by me; exert yourself among the associates, or go away; then you will obtain the remainder of the paṇas.”
notes: The thing that has become plentiful is not stated (presumably the wares of the previous unit). abhityakta follows the glossary (given up to death). vikramasva: 'exert yourself' (alternatively 'show prowess, advance'); sāmavāyika 'associate' (member of the same combination). paṇa is a coin, kept; paṇa-śeṣa literally 'remainder of the paṇas' (alternatively 'balance of the price').

hindi: तब गुप्तचर दूसरों में ग्रहण कराएँ — “यह शत्रु द्वारा दिया गया है।”
english: Then the secret agents should make [it] grasped among the others: “This was given by the enemy.”
notes: grāhayeyuḥ is caus. √grah, 'cause to take / make grasp'; alternatives are 'have it seized' or 'make them believe'. pareṣu is 'among the others'; it may mean 'among the enemy's men'. The content grasped is the quotation.

hindi: अथवा शत्रु द्वारा प्रख्यात किया गया अज्ञात माल विजिगीषु के पास जाए।
english: Or a ware declared by the enemy, unrecognised, might go to the conqueror.
notes: Obscure line. śatru-prakhyāta could be 'made known by the enemy', 'known as the enemy's', or 'famed among enemies'; avijñāta 'unrecognised/unknown' could qualify the ware or be adverbial; gacchet might be 'should go' or 'should be sent'. Do not build on this reading.

words.gloss: agents in the guise of traders
among the chiefs of the enemy

hindi: उसके उस माल को व्यापारी के वेश वाले गुप्तचर शत्रु के मुख्य लोगों में बेचें।
english: That [ware] of his, agents in the guise of traders should sell among the chiefs of the enemy.
notes: tat (the ware, unit 31) is taken as the object; asya 'his' is ambiguous (the conqueror's or the owner's). Glossary: X-vyañjana = agent in the guise of X; vaidehaka = trader.

hindi: तब गुप्तचर दूसरों में ग्रहण कराएँ — “यह माल शत्रु द्वारा दिया गया है।”
english: Then the secret agents should make [it] grasped among the others: “This ware was given by the enemy.”
notes: As in unit 30: grāhayeyuḥ is caus. √grah; alternatives 'have it seized'; pareṣu may mean 'among the enemy's men'.

hindi: अथवा बड़े अपराध करने वालों को धन और मान से सहारा देकर शस्त्र, विष और अग्नि के द्वारा शत्रु पर लगाए।
english: Or, having supported [those guilty of] great offences with wealth and honour, [he] should set [them] upon the enemy with weapon, poison and fire.
notes: mahā-aparādhān is accusative plural 'great offences'; the persons guilty are supplied in brackets. upagṛhya follows the glossary 'having supported'; alternatives 'having taken hold of, embraced'. rasa with śastra and agni = poison (glossary). praṇidadhyāt literally 'should place/set'; the object (them) is implied.

hindi: फिर एक अमात्य को निकाल दे।
english: Then [he] should cast out one minister.
notes: niṣ-√pat caus.: 'cause to fall out, cast out'; alternatives 'banish' or 'send out'. The token 'atha-ekam' is an unsandhied join.

hindi: उसके पुत्र और पत्नी को अपने अधिकार में लेकर प्रसिद्ध कराए कि रात में मारा गया।
english: Having taken hold of his son and wife, [he] should have it proclaimed that [he was] killed in the night.
notes: upagṛhya is rendered literally 'having taken hold of' (the same verb as in unit 34, where the glossary rendering 'having supported' suits the object). putra-dāra is a singular dvandva (collective, 'sons and wife' is possible). hatam is singular: who was killed is not stated (presumably the minister of unit 35, or someone of his house); the bracket [he] is a guess and should be checked. iti here is quotative ('that').

hindi: तब अमात्य शत्रु के उनको एक-एक करके बताए।
english: Then the minister should set forth those of the enemy one by one.
notes: śatroḥ may belong with tān ('those of the enemy') or be read as 'to the enemy'; tān is not identified. prarūpayet is rendered 'set forth' (alternatives: describe, point out, present). The token 'atha-amātyaḥ' is an unsandhied join.
